column1: # The checks of shell/storageless-password.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# A PASSWORD of VarStoreId 0, which names no VarStore, keeps its password through its callbacks
# or READ and WRITE ops where uefisettings cannot tell, EFI_IFR_FLAG_CALLBACK or not, so in any
# variable: get, keyword get, keyword set, list-questions and set read and write none, of either
# package list, even with --i-am-fine-to-brick-this-system, which lifts none of that, so set and
# keyword set warn of nothing, and nothing shows 0x3E17A95C, which SlBacking holds where the
